description: This file defines the 'BundleData' class used in the build system for managing bundle-related information such as assets, dependencies, output paths, and configuration attributes.

classes.name: BundleData
classes.description: Class encapsulating data and methods for managing bundle creation and configuration in the build system.

methods.name: GetAssetsCatalogDirectory
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the outermost assets catalog directory from a source file.

methods.name: AddBundleData
methods.description: Adds a target to the collection of bundle data dependencies.

methods.name: OnTargetResolved
methods.description: Handles actions after the owning target has been resolved.

methods.name: GetSourceFiles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of source files used by the bundle.

methods.name: GetOutputFiles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of output files generated by the bundle.

methods.name: GetOutputsAsSourceFiles
methods.description: Retrieves output files as source file objects.

methods.name: GetCompiledAssetCatalogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the compiled asset catalog.

methods.name: GetBundleRootDirOutput
methods.description: Returns the top-level directory of the bundle as a source file.

methods.name: GetBundleRootDirOutputAsDir
methods.description: Returns the bundle root directory as a directory object.

methods.name: GetBundleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the bundle resides.
